body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial design photograph of a daily-carry aerial camera quadcopter. Orthographic 90-degree overhead, nose at twelve o'clock. True X, four motors, arms at 45 degrees to the nose axis, square hub layout, opposite hubs 250 mm apart. Four stationary propellers, each a single balanced pair of opposite equal blades, 125 mm tip to tip. Pebble body, 1.6:1. At twelve o'clock the pale nose forms a shallow scalloped visor over a recessed charcoal optical housing. Its small smoked crown and two side reveals are visible from above; the glass aperture is concealed on the vertical forward face. Each arm grows from a broad radiused shoulder, the upper skin sweeping into the first third of the arm. Satin warm-grey molded shell, graphite composite arms, charcoal blades. Soft 5500 K sidelight, defined contact shadows, pale seamless background. Use the four reference endpoints for motor locations. Unlettered product, full aircraft in frame.
